platform: Pixel 10, native Debian 13 ARM64, X11 with VirGL/Zink
build_note: Native checks used the collaboration build before the final rollback-row width fix and sweep/loft additions. Later final-build checks are recorded separately.
native_checks: Constructed a centered 30x30 mm square with driving dimensions and Equal, zero remaining degrees of freedom, then extruded 10 mm and saved.
Reloaded concurrent agent edits to 40x40x5 mm, edited extrusion depth through the desktop UI, and verified stale-save rejection and separate Save as.
Opened the 29-entry housing and its resized variant; inspected all holes, bosses, fillets and internal pocket in isometric and rotated views.
Collapsed the feature tree with Tab, fitted the view, and orbited the housing.
Opened the resized housing in a 1024x1300 window. Fit retained the complete solid. Sketch Finish and Cancel remained accessible with the properties panel open.
Double-clicked an existing housing sketch dimension and verified its named expression in the edit popup.

upstream_edit_limit.change: Body profile Height changed from #depth=76.2 mm to 80 mm while leaving the base depth unchanged.
upstream_edit_limit.result: The body overhang changes the base/body intersection. A downstream corner fillet reports missing edge f2:side:1:2 | f4:side:1:3 rather than choosing another edge. Later dependent features fail explicitly.
upstream_edit_limit.recovery: Ctrl+Z restored the original housing. The source document on disk was not changed.

discovered_ui_defect: Rollback row underestimated its label/button widths and expanded the feature panel. A measured-layout fix was subsequently implemented and tested headlessly; native final-build verification remains separate.
